solution: Closed-loop denominator: s²(s+4) + K(s+α) = s³ + 4s² + Ks + Kα. Wanted poles −1 ± j√3 give the factor s² + 2s + 4; with a third pole at −p the polynomial is s³ + (2+p)s² + (4+2p)s + 4p. Matching: 4 = 2+p → p = 2; K = 4 + 2p = 8; Kα = 4p = 8 → α = 1.
principle: Desired poles → desired characteristic polynomial. Match coefficients one by one; solve for K and α last.

solution: Output B = 1 when the highest-priority active input is D₂ (code 01) or D₁ (code 10). D₂ contributes only if D₃ is inactive, D₁ only if both D₃ and D₂ are inactive: B = D̄₃D₂ + D̄₃D̄₂D₁, which simplifies to D̄₃D₂ + D̄₃D₁.
principle: Priority encoder: an input only matters when every higher-priority input is 0 — each term carries the complemented higher-priority inputs.
